title: Signature Launch session contract — the eight launch answers, typed, from intake to plan
owner: audit lane L01 (UL-003); sole writer of this file
purpose: One versioned contract for the eight launch answers a Signature Launch must carry end to end, the provenance every consumer may rely on, the approval invalidation cases, and the complete-plan digest fixture the Skill 50 consumer adapter (lane L06) reads. Additive changes only; bump contract_version when a lane must change how it reads an existing field.

producers.session_ledger: signature-launch-intake/v1 (49-signature-funnel/scripts/launch_intake.py); each answer is {value, state, source_ref, question_id, provenance}
producers.assembled_plan: launch-plan.schema.json 1.0.0 plus the additive launch_answers block defined here

states.provided: the client said it; usable as a fact
states.verified_existing: confirmed against an existing record or a supplied brand file
states.recommended_unapproved: a default or a recommendation; never an approval, never a client fact
states.approved_recommendation: a recommendation the client approved together with the plan
states.unknown: not supplied; never coerced to a value, never to false, never to a deadline
states.not_applicable: a real answer that nothing applies (for example no paid pieces)

launch_answers.type: object of ISO 8601 date-time strings plus one IANA timezone
launch_answers.rule: Parsed only from the client's own sentence; a component that was not stated stays unknown and is named by the plan. Never defaulted, never invented. 'launch at noon' takes the doors-open day only because the client gave one day for the launch.
launch_answers.state_rule: provided only for the components actually stated; otherwise unknown

launch_answers.type: array of channel tokens, subset of ["email", "text"]
launch_answers.rule: "Email only" -> ["email"]; "Email and text" -> ["email", "text"]. A list is normalised; anything unusable is unknown. Never a raw display string.
launch_answers.state_rule: a default (Email only) enters as recommended_unapproved until the client confirms it

launch_answers.rule: "Yes, add the bot" -> true; "No, not this launch" -> false. A non-empty string is never truthy. A requested bot with no mode stays blocked by name (mode is a separate missing fact, never guessed).
true plans the access email, access automation and delivery link; false plans none. Never defaulted.
"Payment plans offered" -> true and opens the failed-payment recovery automation; "Paid in full" -> false and forbids it. Never defaulted.
From line and text signature. Blank or non-string is unknown; never invented.
Replies must reach a mailbox the client reads; a no-reply address is refused by the asking layer, not rewritten here.
"Yes, it is approved" -> true; "No, not yet" -> false. The string "No, not yet" must never read as truthy: false keeps every text a draft.
launch_answers.state_rule: a default (No) enters as recommended_unapproved, which a consumer treats as not ready

entry_shape.question_id: the launch question that produced it, or null when ingested

laws: Every ledger entry keeps its provenance through ingest; no consumer re-derives a fact from free text.
A default or a suggestion is recommended_unapproved and can never be read as approved.
An unknown entry is carried, not dropped, and is named by the plan as a missing fact.

plan_block.location: assembled full launch plan (launch-plan.schema.json 1.0.0) at the additive key `launch_answers`
plan_block.content: the eleven ledger keys of the eight answers, each with value, state, source_ref, question_id and provenance
plan_block.why: sender_name, reply_to_email, access_delivery and payment_plans are not fields of launch-plan.schema.json; the block carries them to the consumer without forking the plan schema

approval.binding: the client's approval binds the plan document hash (validate_launch_plan.plan_document_hash) through the gate, and pins the full launch-plan digest (approve() records approved_launch_plan_digest alongside the approved record) so a rebuilt plan that no longer reproduces the digest proves the plan changed after approval

invalidation_cases.trigger: any answer recorded while the session is approved
invalidation_cases.effect: approval cleared, plan_approval_ref cleared, plan status collecting, session returns to collecting; a fresh assemble/present/approve is required
plan and plan_hash cleared, approval cleared, plan_revision incremented, session state revision_requested
same as answer_changed_after_approval; the pinned full-plan digest is cleared too

invalidation_cases.trigger: ingest_answers() while the session is building
invalidation_cases.effect: refused with a message naming request_revision(); the ledger and the approval are untouched

invalidation_cases.trigger: the plan changed (price, offer, route, revision) or the approval belongs to another plan
invalidation_cases.effect: approval rejected with a message naming the hash mismatch

invalidation_cases.trigger: recorded_at older than the gate window (default 72 hours)
invalidation_cases.effect: approval rejected; a new client approval is required

invalidation_cases.trigger: owner_identity_ref is not the launch's client identity
owner_identity_ref equals the worker operating the run
validate_launch returns violations at approval time
invalidation_cases.effect: approval refused, never spent on an unbuildable plan

invalidation_cases.trigger: approve() called while collecting or with no assembled plan
invalidation_cases.effect: actionable refusal naming the state and the required assemble/present step

invalidation_cases.trigger: answer() while the session is building
invalidation_cases.effect: refused; a change must go through request_revision()

digest.input: the complete launch plan document exactly as published (including the launch_answers block)

L06_skill50.owns: the Skill 50 consumer adapter (not edited by lane L01)
required_behavior: Read channels as an array; text work is planned only when 'text' is present, and never from a display string.
Read a2p_ready, conversation_ai, access_delivery and payment_plans as real booleans. Treat any non-boolean or recommended_unapproved/unknown state as NOT ready and NOT approved.
a2p_ready false or unapproved keeps every text draft_only and attaches the warning that texts cannot send until A2P is approved; never send.
access_delivery true plans the access email, access automation and delivery link; false plans none.
payment_plans true plans the failed-payment recovery automation; false forbids it.
sender_name and reply_to_email must be present and non-empty before any email or text is composed; a missing one blocks that unit by name, never a placeholder.
Every deadline comes from launch_calendar as an ISO 8601 timestamp; never invent, round or shift one, and refuse a calendar whose timezone is unknown.
Never treat recommended_unapproved as approved; the plan's approval binds the plan hash, so a changed plan requires a new client approval.
Verify the fixture plan digest with the digest rules above before consuming a plan handed to a different lane.
